name: melody-research
description: Evidence-first literature discovery, paper review, citation auditing, systematic review, and reproducible experiment design for Melody Research.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-first research skills and literature tools.
interface.longDescription: A local Research plugin with six complementary skills, a provenance-aware literature MCP server, and prompts for paper review and reproducible study design.
defaultPrompt: Turn my research question into a reproducible literature search.
Review this paper and separate evidence from interpretation.
Audit these citations before I use them in a manuscript.
